description: Finds administrative boundaries (countries, states, counties, cities, districts) and postcode areas by name, in any language. Filter by country, kind or admin_level; bias toward a point with near. Free and public. Returns candidates with id, kind, admin_level, country, parents, bbox, centroid and population, but no polygon: pass the id to get_boundary for that. A street address or a landmark is not a boundary: when nothing is named that but the text matched one, results is empty and located gives its point (name, kind, lat, lon) with a hint to call reverse_boundaries for every boundary containing it.

admin_level.description: Only this OSM admin_level (2 = country; meaning varies by country below that).

country.description: Limit to countries: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, comma-separated (e.g. US or de,at,ch).

kind.description: Only this kind (normalized across countries): country, state, region, province, county, district, municipality, city, borough, ward, neighbourhood, postal_code.

limit.description: At most this many results (1–40, default 10).

near.description: lat,lon to prefer results near, e.g. 37.77,-122.42.

q.description: A place name, e.g. "Berlin", "Alameda County", "75011". A street address returns located (its point) instead of results.

name: search_boundaries
title: Search boundaries
